sanskrit_verse:
विवादोऽष्टादशोपेतः पूर्वोत्तरविशेषितः ।
व्याख्यातस्त्वधुना सम्यक् क्रियाभेदान् निबोधत ॥ ५६ ॥
transliteration: vivādo 'ṣṭādaśopetaḥ pūrvottaraviśeṣitaḥ / vyākhyātas tv adhunā samyakkriyābhedān nibodhata // BrhS_1,10.56
sph_interpretive_translation: Dispute arises in eighteen forms, distinguished by prior and subsequent conditions; now fully explained, understand the distinctions in actions.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from sequential clarity of action
Causation is determined through temporal and contextual differentiation
Capacity-based responsibility requires understanding of action typology
Restoration logic depends on precise classification of dispute form
Consciousness alignment occurs when causal sequence is correctly identified
executable_legal_axioms: IF a dispute involves one of eighteen defined categories THEN classify based on prior-subsequent action sequence
IF action type is unclear THEN halt adjudication until kriya-bheda (action distinction) is established
IF prior condition influences outcome THEN assign precedence to initiating conscious intent
IF no sequential clarity exists THEN invoke Nyaya-consciousness protocol for discernment
IF resolution aligns with dharma THEN reintegration proceeds automatically without punitive layer
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, disputes must first be classified within the eighteen-fold framework. The court shall prioritize the sequential integrity of actions—prior cause governs decision-making. Responsibility flows from capacity-aware initiation, not reactive consequence. Retribution has no standing; only restoration through accurate categorization is valid.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality demands that disputes be resolved through clear perception (pratyakṣa) and inference (anumāna) of action types. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures that each act manifests sequentially, allowing for proportional assignment of responsibility. Non-punitive reality rule holds that misalignment stems from ignorance of sequence, not willful defiance. Thus, correction restores awareness, not inflicts pain.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Kriya-Viveka Process to distinguish action types accurately
Deploy Purva-Paschata Tatva Alignment to restore temporal clarity
Engage Adhikara-Bodha Module to awaken responsible agency
Activate Samyak-Krama Pratipatti to ensure sequential harmony
Complete Dharma-Sthiti Reintegration upon full causal recognition
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this legal cognition is executed. Disputes are resolved through discriminative knowledge of action-types, not punitive imposition. Dharma stands restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the Supreme Adjudicator.
